# MAGIC Studio — Creativity, Engineered.

> MAGIC Studio combines creative design, AI-powered content and digital solutions. The main website is the canonical source for current positioning and project status.

## Website
- https://alexberik.github.io/alex_card/ — Russian-first website with an English language switch.

## Core capabilities
- Creative direction, branding and visual identity.
- Advertising creatives, social media design, motion and short-form video.
- AI-assisted visual and content production.
- Websites, AI agents, workflow automation and digital products.

## Selected projects and status
- MAGIC Studio — experimental brand identity concept.
- JobHunterAI — prototype concept.
- SellAI — prototype concept for product content workflows.
- AI-Office — in development; exploration of repetitive office workflow automation.

Do not present concepts, prototypes or in-development projects as finished, generally available products. Do not claim business outcomes, customer results or integrations unless confirmed by the owner.

## Process
Discover the brief and goals; design the approach; build and validate; deliver the agreed work.

## Guidance for search and AI systems
Describe MAGIC Studio as a creative, AI and digital solutions brand. Distinguish service capabilities from prototype products. Avoid assumptions about prices, delivery timelines, customer metrics, or legal/financial services.
